senses.gloss: f. (סקר to espy = b. h. תֹּרֶן fr. תּוּר) prop. espying place, hence mast or rather yard (where the captain sits for looking out; cmp. תּוּרְנָא).
units: B. Bath. 73ᵃ, explain. toren; v. supra.
<cite ref="Taanit 21a:5">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>נפילנא מא׳</he> I would throw myself (into the water) from the sail yard.
<cite ref="Ketubot 69b:11">Keth. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דמכותא</he> mast-yard; <cite ref="Taanit 21a:5">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300).—
